the microglial profile of the ageing brain is not homogenous, and that microglia can be further subdivided by their immunoreactive profiles.

The main takeaway from our work is that
microglia are not a homogeneous cell population, and that their phenotype is highly context dependent.
microglial markers are not interchangeable and that a combination is required for a more comprehensive analysis of microglial phenotypes.
